outcomes.observations: not(x = 1) removed derivation #1 (and its output from the state); entry 1 stays in L. expressibility.reason: Each computation is transcribed (loop, rev, conc: all P), but Absys has one computation per session: the primary's two SPAWN texts are conjoined by the harness into one derivation (A5), and a conjunction with loop(x) has no solutions, so B's b = <3,2,1> is not a solution of what the system holds. Two computations sharing no unknowns can be written as the two alternatives of one or (variants P09a.AB.or, P09a.BA.or: 3 R tokens, {, or, }), each a derivation of its own, which keeps each computation's solutions on every input sharing no unknowns. Under depth-first the or's order decides whether B runs, which is operational, not meaning.

As P09a: conjoined (primary), A's failure removes the only derivation and B is reported unsatisfiable; the or variant (3 R tokens) keeps each computation's outcomes, A's failure being its own derivation's.

genu and sum3 transcribed (all P). Under P09d1 the least relation and under P09d2 the stream reading, the same text; Absys builds the partial list incrementally.
Two arithmetic relations, transcribed (all P).

notes.mode_differences: Every cost and storage record of P09, P10, P11, in all three configurations, gives the same classification on every stage as its behaviour run (scripts compare_modes.py and compare_modes.out). The only difference is attempt history: in P09d the behaviour run hit the 60 s limit once before its rerun reached the budget, while the cost and storage runs reached the budget at the first attempt. No raw-rerun-m2 records exist for these problems.
